title: Sahara Sand's Secret Song

scenes.text: The Sahara dunes can produce a 110‑Hz hum
Researchers recorded a low‑frequency sound up to 110 hertz from dunes in Egypt's Siwa Oasis.
scenes.query: Siwa Oasis dune sound recording 110 hertz

scenes.text: The noise only appears when the sand is dry, well‑rounded, and about a tenth of a millimetre in size.
scenes.query: dry sand grain size 0.1 mm singing dunes

scenes.text: It isn’t wind at all—moving sand grains vibrate like a massive speaker.
scenes.query: sand grain vibration speaker effect dunes

scenes.text: Follow so you never run out of fun facts.
